adversarial reviewer says escalate: plan.md's Order of work step 8 and Proof section both instruct running `python evals/check.py --case "0006-*"` to prove the new eval case passes, but `evals/check.py` does not exist anywhere in this repository (confirmed: no such file at the root, and docs/progress/session-5.md item 10 records this exact mistake as a previously-fixed 'medium' finding -- 'no evals/check.py here... the copy removed; framework-evals.yml is this repository's' -- so the design pass has reintroduced a known-wrong command). The correct invocation for this repo, matching .github/workflows/framework-evals.yml and spec.md's own Acceptance line ('passes under plugin/evals/run.py'), is `python plugin/evals/run.py --fixture --case "0006-*"`. spec.md and plan.md now disagree on the command that proves the same acceptance requirement, and plan.md repeats the wrong one twice; following plan.md literally in phase (c) would fail or force an undocumented departure from the plan it is supposed to pin down.
